jobs.description: At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Manager of Contact Center & Customer Support to build, scale, and operate the support organization behind a global travel and events program spanning 60+ countries. Key job responsibilities Strategy & Operating Model - Design, build, and continuously improve a structured contact center operating model including workflows, service standards, escalation paths, quality expectations, performance metrics, and reporting cadence fit for a global, multi-country, multi-language travel and events program. - Define the channel strategy (phone, chat, messaging, email, social, self-service, in-app) and the customer journey across planning, booking, pre-trip/event, in-trip/event disruption/emergency support, and post-trip/event resolution. - Partner with regional and global stakeholders to ensure the support model reflects local regulatory, language, and cultural requirements across all 60+ countries while maintaining a globally consistent standard of service. - Act as a strategic partner to senior leadership, bringing data-driven recommendations on staffing, technology investment, and process design to executive planning and business reviews; drive automation and reduce operating costs. - Influence cross-organizational priorities aligning technology, product, procurement, and regional operations teams around a shared support vision without direct reporting authority over those teams Technology, Automation & AI - Own the cross-channel automation strategy (based on the data and customer insight that frames the problem to solve) panning voice, chat, messaging, email, and social, other. Sets the customer experience using automation capabilities and systems that understand and respond to customer requests and automates repetitive back office workflows. - Partner with internal technology teams including product managers to drive the contact center technology roadmap leveraging world-class solutions including the telephony platform, case/ticket management systems, workforce management tools, and AI-enabled support. - Drive the agent-assist technology roadmap including AI-generated summaries, real-time suggestions, knowledge retrieval, and speech/interaction analytics to improve agent efficiency and customer outcomes. - Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce cost-to-serve while improving speed and consistency of resolution, with clear governance around accuracy, data privacy, security, and human oversight for AI-assisted support. - Set the vision for personalization and proactive support experiences across channels, leveraging customer journey data, sentiment analysis, and behavioral analytics. - Build the requirements for new tools and solutions; manage third-party vendor relationships, contracts, and performance against SLAs. - Drive adoption of self-service and containment strategies appropriate to travel and events support to free agents for complex, high-touch, or time-sensitive cases (disruptions, emergencies). Process & Case Management - Establish and enforce superior case/ticket management practices: intake, triage, prioritization, ownership, escalation, and closure, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks in a high-volume, always-on environment. - Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and playbooks for common and edge-case travel and events scenarios (cancellations, rebookings, disruptions, emergencies, VIP handling, vendor escalations). - Lead root-cause analysis on recurring issues, automation failures, and escalation patterns turning support data into upstream fixes with product, policy, technology and supplier/vendor teams. - Build scalable processes that flex with seasonality, program growth, and new market/country launches without degrading service. - Drive a culture of continuous process improvement leveraging structured methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) to systematically eliminate waste and improve quality. Performance Management: SLAs & KPIs - Own and continuously refine the performance dashboard: response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, abandonment rate, service level (SL%), CSAT/CES/NPS, quality scores, schedule adherence, cost-to-serve, deflection rate, average handling time impact, and automation containment rate. - Leverage journey analytics, speech analytics, and real-time interaction analytics to identify optimization opportunities across channels and automation touchpoints. - Set clear SLAs and KPIs by channel, region, and case type, and hold the organization accountable through regular operating cadences (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly reviews). - Build forecasting, staffing, and capacity models that account for global time zones, seasonality (peak travel periods), and event-driven volume spikes. - Translate performance data into action plans that close gaps in service levels, quality, or efficiency. Workforce & Leadership - Lead the contact center function through managers, supervisors, and specialized leads setting strategy, priorities, budgets, and performance expectations, and developing bench strength for succession. - Ensure automation strategy is tightly integrated with workforce planning as self-service and AI capabilities mature, proactively realign agent roles, training, skill requirements, and capacity models. - Build a culture of accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making across a globally distributed team (in-house and/or outsourced/BPO). - Own recruiting, training curricula, coaching frameworks, and quality assurance programs that scale across regions and languages including agent readiness for new automation tools and workflows. - Manage relationships with outsourced partners where applicable, including performance management and program economics. Financial & Vendor Stewardship - Own the contact center budget: staffing, technology, and vendor costs balancing service quality with cost-to-serve discipline. - Manage strategic vendor and supplier relationships (technology platforms, business partners, travel suppliers) including contract performance and renewal strategy.

UAS Pilot and Operations Specialist Job Description Oxy is seeking an experienced UAS Pilot and Operations Specialist to support inspection and asset integrity activities across Oxy’s offshore operations. The position will primarily conduct unmanned aircraft system (UAS) inspections of offshore production facilities and associated infrastructure, providing high-quality visual and sensor data to Mechanical Integrity, Corrosion, Facilities Engineering, Operations and Maintenance teams. The successful candidate will combine strong UAS flight skills with a safety-focused field mindset and the ability to recognize, document and communicate potential equipment and structural integrity concerns. This position will work closely with offshore operations and technical teams to expand the use of UAS technology for safer, more efficient and more comprehensive inspection of difficult-to-access equipment and structures. Roles and Responsibilities Safely plan and execute UAS inspection missions on offshore production facilities, with primary emphasis on mechanical integrity and asset integrity applications. Conduct detailed visual inspections of piping, pressure equipment, structural members, flare systems, risers, piping supports, decks, cranes, tanks, vessels and other offshore infrastructure. Capture high-resolution imagery, video and other sensor data necessary to support mechanical integrity, corrosion and engineering assessments. Identify and document observable conditions including corrosion, coating degradation, structural deterioration, damaged insulation, leaks, loose or missing components and other potential integrity concerns. Coordinate inspection activities with Mechanical Integrity, Corrosion, Facilities Engineering, Operations, Maintenance and HSE personnel. Develop flight and inspection plans based on inspection scope, equipment configuration, operating conditions, airspace restrictions and offshore hazards. Conduct pre-flight risk assessments and participate in applicable offshore permitting, Job Safety Analysis and simultaneous operations planning. Maintain strict compliance with Oxy HSE requirements, offshore operating procedures, FAA regulations and internal UAS policies and standards. Evaluate environmental and operational conditions—including wind, weather, electromagnetic interference, obstacles and active process equipment—to determine whether UAS operations can be conducted safely. Maintain UAS aircraft, batteries, payloads, cameras and supporting equipment in mission-ready condition. Manage inspection imagery and associated data to ensure appropriate quality, traceability, organization and transfer to engineering and inspection personnel. Assist technical teams in developing standardized UAS inspection procedures, image-capture requirements and repeatable inspection routes. Support periodic and repeat inspections that allow engineering teams to monitor equipment condition and degradation over time. Work with inspection and engineering personnel to integrate UAS-generated information into existing mechanical integrity and risk-based inspection programs. Support the evaluation and deployment of emerging UAS technologies, including advanced imaging, thermal sensors, photogrammetry, automated flight planning, remote inspection technologies and AI-enabled image analysis. Identify opportunities where UAS inspections can reduce personnel exposure, scaffolding, rope access, vessel support or other conventional inspection requirements while maintaining appropriate inspection quality. Prepare clear inspection documentation and communicate significant observations promptly to appropriate offshore and technical personnel. Maintain required flight logs, aircraft records, maintenance records, certifications and other regulatory documentation. Support UAS operations at onshore facilities or other Oxy assets as business needs require. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. Qualifications Required High school diploma or equivalent. FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate. Demonstrated experience operating UAS in industrial, energy, infrastructure, construction, inspection or similar environments. Strong understanding of safe UAS flight planning, aircraft limitations, weather considerations and operational risk management. Ability to work safely in an offshore oil and gas operating environment. Ability to recognize and accurately document equipment and structural conditions using visual inspection techniques. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data and inspection quality. Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively with operations personnel, inspectors, engineers and technical specialists. Ability and willingness to travel offshore and work non-routine schedules as required. Ability to obtain and maintain required offshore safety training and certifications. Valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable company requirements for offshore travel. Preferred 3+ years of UAS flight experience, including industrial inspection applications. Experience conducting UAS inspections on offshore platforms, oil and gas facilities, petrochemical facilities, pipelines or other complex industrial assets. Experience supporting mechanical integrity, corrosion, nondestructive examination (NDE/NDT), structural inspection or facilities maintenance programs. Familiarity with offshore production equipment, piping systems, pressure vessels, flare systems, structural components and corrosion mechanisms. Experience with thermal imaging, high-resolution optical inspection, photogrammetry, 3D modeling or other advanced UAS payloads. Experience operating UAS in challenging environments involving structures, confined operating areas, high winds or complex industrial hazards. Knowledge of API, ASME or other applicable mechanical integrity and inspection standards. NDT certification, API inspection certification or related inspection training is a plus. Experience with UAS data-management, inspection-management or image-analysis software. Experience developing UAS procedures, inspection workflows or standardized flight plans. Skills and Competencies The successful candidate will demonstrate: A strong commitment to safety and operational discipline. Personal accountability and sound judgment in field operations. Technical curiosity and an interest in applying new technology to solve operational problems. Strong observational and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while maintaining close coordination with offshore operations and technical teams. Ability to recognize when conditions require stopping or modifying a planned UAS operation. High standards for inspection quality, documentation and data management. Initiative and a continuous-improvement mindset. Ability to communicate technical observations clearly and objectively. Working Conditions This position requires frequent travel to offshore production facilities in the Gulf of Mexico. Work may involve transportation by helicopter or marine vessel, extended offshore workdays, exposure to heat, humidity, wind and other environmental conditions, and operation around active industrial equipment. The position requires the ability to carry and operate UAS equipment, work outdoors for extended periods and perform duties while wearing required personal protective equipment. The UAS Pilot is expected to exercise independent stop-work authority when flight, weather, equipment or operating conditions do not support safe execution of the planned mission. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개

In-depth knowledge of Dutch and Belgium labor law and procedures relating to works councils and labor unions. Proven experience supporting reorganisations, restructurings, transformations or sensitive organisational change programmes across a multi-country European scope. Strong demonstrated ability to support multiple countries, stakeholders and legal environments, operating effectively in a multi-country matrix organisation. Experience in managing labor relations and negotiating with employee representative bodies, as well as in drafting consultation documents and company agreements. Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, judgement and influence, including making recommendations on matters with material legal, employee relations, reputational or business risk. Be able to be locally present onsite in Medemblik and Hoegaarden for individual employee meetings for face-to-face support.
